releases.notes: - Clicking the 'Snapture is running' startup notification now opens Settings

- New 'Launch on startup' toggle in Settings (General)
- Release-notes dialog is now paginated: opens on your current version with newer/older navigation

- Fixed a render-thread crash / display freeze from over-aggressive memory trimming
- Much lower, steady memory use (snapshots use the lightweight capture path; recording still uses the GPU backend)
- WebP recordings now play at the correct speed
- Added a log file (Settings has a button to open it) to help diagnose issues

- Selection mini-toolbar: crop to a display or window, keep-aspect-ratio lock, and a ruler with on-screen measurements
- Arrow keys nudge the selection 1px and accelerate when held; scroll grows/shrinks a committed selection
- R / Shift+R step through recent capture positions; Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y undo/redo
- Picker settings tab: main + selection toolbar positions, and a keyboard-shortcuts dialog
- Settings window flashes when re-opened while already visible

- New capture engine (Windows.Graphics.Capture): fixes custom .ani cursors rendering as a black box and periodic recording corruption
- No-activate picker: dropdowns/menus in other apps stay open while you select
- Picker keyboard & scroll: Enter/Esc, R / Shift+R to reload recent capture positions, Ctrl+Z/Y undo-redo, and scroll to grow/shrink a selection
- New Picker settings tab: choose the toolbar position (corners or edges; sides go vertical)
- Settings window flashes when re-opened while already visible
- Snapshots now freeze the screen the moment you invoke them, so menus, dropdowns and other transient popups are captured instead of vanishing (like Snipaste)
- Removed the redundant Close button in the update dialog (the window X still closes it)

- Update bell is now green and centered
- Manually checking for updates opens the update dialog automatically when one is found
- Install button matches the app's default accent color
- Settings window now opens on the General tab by default

- Update feed moved to GitHub Releases + raw manifest (no more Pages deploy dependency)
- Update-available toast + blue install dialog
- Native snapshot/recording toasts with preview
- Stream Deck plugin support, global shortcuts, snapshot mode

- Snapshot mode with clipboard + preview toasts
- Logical-area snap for custom selection
- Display picker with live cursor
- Stream Deck plugin support (displays/windows, repeat, open-last)
- Global shortcuts (F1 picker, F6 snapshot, F7 record) — configurable
- General settings tab, default snap mode, GPU-composited overlay
